blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipinos may now fly directly from Manila to Paris and vice versa starting Oct. 19 after a temporary seasonal suspension. Air France will resume nonstop flights between Paris and Manila in October after a five-month pause, just in time for the peak holiday travel season. On Tuesday, Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia), the country’s main gateway, announced that flights suspended from May to October will resume operating three times a week.
